name: Sanctuary
reason: Out of scope as it stands now: www.sanctuaryworld.co (robots.txt allows us; domain confirmed on its own home page) and its app-store title 'Sanctuary Psychic Reading' present it as a pay-per-minute marketplace of psychic, tarot, astrology and mediumship readers ('first reading for $1 / min', readers at $2.99-$19.99/min), not a practice or learning app, and its signature programmes are framed on healing after a breakup. Owner may revisit if paid psychic-reading marketplaces are wanted.
